nodes.description: Public constant supply cap (2000) used as the mint amount for every genesis card.
PLATINUM_CARD_ID=0 ... BLUE_CARD_ID=4 public card identifier state variables.
mapping(uint256=>string) of IPFS content identifiers per token id.
mapping(uint256=>address) creator registry, the basis of every creatorOnly authorization.
mapping(uint256=>uint256) minted supply per token id, mutated with SafeMath.add.
OpenSea ProxyRegistry address used to whitelist operator approvals.
mapping(uint256=>string) per-token URI override (inherited from ERC1155Tradable).
mapping(address=>uint256) meta-transaction nonces used for signature replay protection.
ERC1155 mapping(uint256=>mapping(address=>uint256)) balances written/read during mint, burn and transfer.
ERC1155 operator approval mapping consulted by isApprovedForAll.
Public payable meta-transaction entrypoint that verifies a signature then self-calls address(this) with caller-supplied calldata.
onlyOwner batch burn in CryptellionGenesis; body calls burnBatch(from, ids, amounts) instead of _burnBatch, producing unbounded self-recursion.
onlyOwner single burn that delegates to the internal ERC1155 _burn.
onlyOwner token-type creation: records creator, optional URI, mints initial supply and records tokenSupply.
creatorOnly mint of additional quantity for an existing id, incrementing tokenSupply.
Public batch mint that checks creators[_id] against _msgSender per id and then calls _mintBatch.
setCreator loop / internal _setCreator, creatorOnly protected reassignment of creators[_id].
Overridden approval check that trusts the OpenSea proxy registry mapping before falling back to ERC1155 approvals.
onlyOwner batch setter of _ipfsCids, gated by _areValidTokenIds.
onlyOwner direct write to customUri plus URI event.
Private validation loop rejecting tokenIds >= 4, which incorrectly excludes BLUE_CARD_ID = 4.
Internal signature verification using ecrecover over the EIP712 typed hash.
Hashes the MetaTransaction struct fields with the meta-transaction typehash.
Overridden URI getter returning customUri[_id] when set, otherwise the base ERC1155 URI.
Internal ERC1155 mint that updates _balances and triggers receiver acceptance check.
Internal ERC1155 burn with unchecked balance subtraction after a balance require.
Internal ERC1155 batch mint looping _balances updates then calling the batch acceptance check.
Private helper performing an external try/catch call into IERC1155Receiver when the recipient is a contract.
ContextMixin helper that returns msg.sender or, for self calls, an address appended to msg.data.
Constructor wiring name/symbol/URI/proxy registry, setting up IPFS mapping and minting the full genesis supply.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, creator checks, relayer identity and ERC1155 authorization.
Self-recursive burnBatch call that never terminates (stack exhaustion / permanent DoS for the owner path).
address(this).call(abi.encodePacked(functionSignature, userAddress)) executing arbitrary calldata in the contract context.
ecrecover based signature check; malleability and nonce handling determine meta-transaction authorization.
External onERC1155Received/onERC1155BatchReceived call into an attacker-controlled recipient contract.
unchecked block balance subtraction (fromBalance - amount) that relies solely on the preceding require.
Recipient of the initial mint in create().
Token id supplied to create()/burn(), used for existence and creator lookups.
Initial mint amount in create(), stored in tokenSupply.
Arbitrary bytes forwarded to the ERC1155 receiver during minting.
Signer/account supplied to executeMetaTransaction, appended to the self-call payload.
Raw calldata executed by the meta-transaction self call.
Signature recovery id passed to ecrecover via verify().
Source address of burn/burnBatch operations.
Amount to burn in burn().
Array of token ids iterated in burnBatch()/batchMint().
Array of token ids validated and written in setCidBatch().
Array of IPFS CIDs written into _ipfsCids by setCidBatch().
Recipient address of mint().
New URI value written to customUri by setCustomURIViaOwner().
MetaTransaction struct assembled in executeMetaTransaction from nonce, userAddress and functionSignature.
Cached _balances value read before the unchecked subtraction in _burn.
Operator address (msgSender) passed into the ERC1155 receiver acceptance call.
Nonce read in getNonce()/executeMetaTransaction, incremented after verification.
Private constructor helper calling create() five times with MAX_SUPPLY_PER_CARD for each genesis card id.

edges.reason: ContextMixin.msgSender reads msg.sender (or appended msg.data) to resolve the effective sender used by meta-transactions.
Any external caller can invoke executeMetaTransaction; msg.sender is only recorded as the relayer, the real authorisation comes from the signature.
create() is gated by onlyOwner, which compares owner() to _msgSender().
mint() uses the creatorOnly(_id) modifier requiring creators[_id] == _msgSender().
setCreator/_setCreator rely on the creatorOnly modifier evaluated against _msgSender().
burnBatch() is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner using _msgSender().
isApprovedForAll is queried with _msgSender() during safeTransferFrom authorization, so the trusted proxy registry entry decides transfer permission.
create() writes creators[_id] = _msgSender(), making the caller the permanent creator authority for that token id.
userAddress selects the nonce slot, is hashed into the signed payload and is appended to the executed calldata.
functionSignature is the caller supplied calldata that will be executed by the contract itself.
sigV (with sigR/sigS) feeds ecrecover, so the recovered signer is fully caller-influenced input.
executeMetaTransaction requires verify(userAddress, metaTx, sigR, sigS, sigV) to succeed.
Verification path hashes the MetaTransaction struct before recovery.
verify() calls hashMetaTransaction(metaTx) to build the digest it recovers from.
Signature acceptance depends on ecrecover over the typed message hash; a mismatched or malleable signature changes authorisation.
metaTx fields (nonce, from, functionSignature hash) are the data hashed by hashMetaTransaction.
executeMetaTransaction performs a low level address(this).call with attacker supplied calldata after incrementing the nonce and emitting the event.
The self call re-enters the contract and can route back into executeMetaTransaction or other state-changing entrypoints.
The raw functionSignature is packed into calldata for the low level self call, giving the caller arbitrary execution.
userAddress is appended to the calldata so ContextMixin.msgSender can recover it during the nested self call.
burnBatch() body calls burnBatch(from, ids, amounts) recursively without any terminating base case.
The ids array parameter is the data the recursive burnBatch call keeps forwarding.
The from address parameter is forwarded unchanged by the recursive burnBatch call.
burn() delegates the actual balance mutation to the internal ERC1155 _burn.
from is the balance holder burned by burn().
amount is subtracted from the source balance inside burn()/_burn().
The token id selects the _balances entry manipulated by burn().
create() mints the initial supply through ERC1155 _mint.
create() writes creators[_id], permanently establishing who may later use creatorOnly functions.
_initialSupply is minted and also stored into tokenSupply[_id].
_initialOwner receives the newly minted tokens in create().
_data is forwarded to the ERC1155 receiver callback during creation minting.
create() optionally writes the supplied URI into customUri[_id].
mint() calls _mint to create additional tokens.
tokenSupply[_id] is increased via SafeMath.add(_quantity) after minting.
_to is the beneficiary address of mint().
batchMint() performs the actual token creation through _mintBatch.
batchMint() individually requires creators[_id] == _msgSender() for every id before minting.
tokenSupply[_id] is incremented per id with SafeMath.add(quantity).
The ids array drives both the creator check loop and the mint batch.
tokenIds is the array validated and used as mapping keys in setCidBatch().
setCidBatch() writes each cid into _ipfsCids[tokenIds[i]].
setCidBatch() requires _areValidTokenIds(tokenIds) before writing.
The bound tokenIds[i] >= 4 hard codes the card id range but BLUE_CARD_ID is 4, so the last card can never pass validation.
cids array supplies the stored IPFS identifiers.
_newURI is the value written into customUri by the owner.
setCustomURIViaOwner writes customUri[_tokenId] = _newURI and emits URI.
The constructor invokes _mintTotalSupply() to seed all genesis cards.
_mintTotalSupply calls create() five times, one per card id.
Every genesis create() call mints MAX_SUPPLY_PER_CARD tokens.
The constructor stores the OpenSea proxy registry address used by isApprovedForAll.
_mint adds to _balances[id][to]; the write occurs before the receiver acceptance check.
_burn reads and rewrites _balances[id][from].
_mint triggers the optional receiver acceptance call after the balance update, giving the recipient external control flow.
_mintBatch triggers the batch receiver acceptance call after updating all balances.
fromBalance caches _balances[id][from] and is then reduced inside an unchecked block.
The operator address (msgSender) is forwarded into the external acceptance call, though only the address/hook matter for reentrancy.
_burn performs _balances[id][from] = fromBalance - amount inside unchecked, relying solely on the preceding require.
_doSafeTransferAcceptanceCheck performs an external call to the recipient contract when it is a contract.
The untrusted receiver can re-enter the contract during the acceptance check (e.g. into mint/batchMint/transfer paths).
isApprovedForAll consults proxyRegistryAddress and returns true for any operator registered in the proxy registry, bypassing normal ERC1155 approvals.
Falls back to ERC1155._operatorApprovals when no registry proxy matches.
uri() returns customUri[_id] when a custom URI was set for the token.

normalization_plan.reason: _initialOwner is a create() argument that flows directly into the mint performed by that core function.
_id is a create() argument used only for the creator/existence bookkeeping of that core function.
_initialSupply is a create() argument written into tokenSupply by that core function.
_data is a create() argument forwarded to the ERC1155 receiver call inside that core function.
userAddress is a parameter of the core executeMetaTransaction entrypoint and has no meaning outside it.
functionSignature is the calldata parameter consumed by the core executeMetaTransaction self call.
sigV is consumed directly by the ecrecover logic inside the core verify function.
from is an address parameter of the core burn() function that selects the balance holder to reduce.
amount is a numeric parameter of the core burn() function subtracted from the ERC1155 balance.
ids is the array parameter that the core burnBatch function recursively forwards and iterates.
tokenIds is the array parameter validated and used as key inside the core setCidBatch function.
cids is the value array parameter written into _ipfsCids by the core setCidBatch function.
_to is the recipient parameter of the core mint() function.
_newURI is the value parameter written to customUri by the core setCustomURIViaOwner function.
metaTx is a local struct built and consumed entirely within the core executeMetaTransaction flow.
fromBalance is a local cache of _balances used by the unchecked subtraction inside the core _burn function.
operator is a local address passed into the external receiver acceptance call performed by the core hook function.
nonce is a local value read and incremented only within the meta-transaction nonce management of the core executeMetaTransaction path.
